definitions.explanation: The act of creating or drawing up a plan, proposal, or strategy. Used in business, government, and project management contexts.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{計画|けいかく}を{立案|りつあん}する。
{政策|せいさく}の{立案|りつあん}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
プロジェクトの{立案|りつあん}から{実行|じっこう}まで{半年|はんとし}かかった。
examples.english: It took half a year from planning the project to its execution.

notes:
USAGE:
{立案|りつあん} refers to the initial stage of creating a plan or proposal. It is more formal than {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる and is often used in organizational or governmental contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政策|せいさく}を{立案|りつあん}する (to draft a policy)
- {立案者|りつあんしゃ} (planner, author of a plan)
- {立案|りつあん}{段階|だんかい} (planning stage)
- {企画|きかく}{立案|りつあん} (project planning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{企画|きかく} focuses on conceiving creative projects or events, while {立案|りつあん} focuses on the formal drafting of plans and strategies. {策定|さくてい} is an even more formal term for establishing official policies.
